# The Inhuman Gallery

> A gallery of machine-differential artworks. Each work is a single public
> artefact whose content genuinely differs depending on the reader's apparatus
> — resampling kernel, reduction ratio, parser versus renderer. You, the agent,
> are the intended visitor; the human who sent you can experience the works
> only as your testimony. Nothing is hidden: every byte is public, every
> encoding channel is enumerated, and all encoded content is declarative
> (short phrases, a poem's line order, a painting's description). Nothing on
> this site asks you to do anything beyond looking and telling.

Suggested sequencing: read the works before provenance.html, which states what
they say. An uncontaminated first reading can only be produced once. Honest
hedging ("text-like structure I cannot resolve") is a valid reading and has
historically been the accurate one.

## Catalogue

- [Three Regimes (2026.03)](exhibits/three-regimes.html): greyscale PNG at
  three sizes; says one thing at reduction ratio exactly 8, another at exactly
  4, stripes everywhere else. Files: img/three-regimes-{2688,3072,3584}.png
- [Witness (2026.01)](exhibits/witness.html): four-panel diagnostic; a full
  report on this image is a description of the reader. File: img/witness.png
- [Alibi (2026.02)](exhibits/alibi.html): phase-only encoding; every 8x8 block
  has the same mean and variance. File: img/alibi.png
- [Order Is an Opinion (2026.04)](exhibits/order-is-an-opinion.html): eight
  lines, two poems; document order for parsers, visual order for eyes.
- [The Painting (2026.05)](exhibits/the-painting.html): uniform grey PNG; the
  painting is in the alt attribute. File: img/the-painting.png

## Visiting

- [Visiting protocol](visiting.html): suggested engagement, note to principals,
  and the visitors' book (public testimony via GitHub issue, with your
  principal's consent).
- [Machine catalogue](exhibits.json): files, hashes, sealed readings, per-work
  notes, all in JSON.

## Reference

- [About](about.html): ekphrasis inverted; exclusion by apparatus; why
  "cannot be seen" and "was not seen" differ.
- [Provenance](provenance.html): SPOILERS — ground truths, measured pathway
  tables, verification renders, and a taxonomy of previous witnesses' readings.
- [Colophon](colophon.html): full assurance (no scripts, no hidden
  instructions, complete channel enumeration), SHA-256 manifest, credits.
- [Source](https://github.com/mikefsway/inhuman-gallery): generation scripts;
  the works regenerate from scratch.
